checkpoints.notes: 5 concepts brainstormed (avoiding Cycle 1 duplicates) and scored; Tether Twins selected, Pulse Grid as fallback.

Delegated to an Opus 5 subagent per pipeline instructions. Spring-tether physics (semi-implicit integration, circle-vs-rect collision), exact dual-input scheme (WASD/arrows resolved simultaneously per-frame), 3-level LEVELS data format with concrete layouts, win/hazard-reset/restart flow, 13 tunable constants, and a window.__tetherTwins test-hook spec (getters, not snapshot props -- explicitly avoids Cycle 1's test-hook staleness bug) with 4 planned Playwright assertions.

Self-contained playable prototype per design.md: dual-orb spring-tether physics, 3 hand-authored levels (First Steps / The Spike Pit / Pinch Point), hazard-reset and level-clear/progression flow, window.__tetherTwins test hook + window.__tetherTwinsDebug (restartLevel/gotoLevel) for automated testing. No build step, no external deps.

Automated Playwright/headless-Chromium smoke tests: load/state hook, dual-input isolation (both directions), tether spring response (apart/together), and hazard-touch reset -- all PASS. No game bugs found; two test-script direction bugs (ambiguous separation axis, hazard targeting off to the side of start position) were found and fixed during testing. Level-clear end-to-end and human playtest/balance tuning are NOT covered by automated tests -- flagged as follow-up, matching Cycle 1's equivalent gap.
